findings.problem: uvx runners pinned by version only, no hash; CI checks sha256
findings.scenario: a new wheel added to an existing PyPI release runs prompt-free on the dev machine
findings.closure: runners hash-pinned (require-hashes) or the gap accepted in research

findings.problem: KIT_LINT_ROOT fixture seam left in the production gate
findings.scenario: an inherited KIT_LINT_ROOT makes the prompt-free gate run another tree's install.sh
findings.closure: the gate prints the root it used, or the seam is fixture-only

findings.problem: kit-lint.sh and test-kit-lint.sh copied into every target (inert)
findings.scenario: kit-only code present in installed projects, exit 2 there
findings.closure: both excluded from copy_tree/copy_kit, or the precedent documented

findings.problem: closed stdin and the install-fails branch are not pinned
findings.scenario: removing </dev/null or breaking the failure branch keeps the suite green
findings.closure: a KL case with an install stub that reads stdin and one that fails, temp cleaned

findings.problem: plan Q6 (kit-repo gate batch = extra-gates, pnpm fence n/a) not written where the shipping agent reads
findings.scenario: an agent treats absent pnpm scripts as red or skips kit-lint on an off-surface diff
findings.closure: Local rules of the kit overlay state Q6

findings.problem: the overlays prune also applies to copy_tree's addon functions call
findings.scenario: an addon functions folder named overlays is silently dropped
findings.closure: prune scoped to the kit .claude tree only

findings.problem: install.sh failure reported FAIL without a lint run, uncovered
findings.scenario: contract says FAIL only after a lint run; branch untested
findings.closure: contract amended or a KL case covers it

findings.problem: KL7 asserts MISSING and reason on separate lines
findings.scenario: a MISSING line without its reason still passes
findings.closure: KL7 asserts the one MISSING line with its reason

findings.scenario: a runner image with system uv fails KL6 for an unrelated reason
findings.closure: KL6 uses a PATH with no uvx by construction

findings.problem: K2a suite list not extended; separate grep pins test-kit-lint
findings.closure: one place pins the CI suite list
